text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"A H A   H A   H A     H A A   HAHA ! ! !
!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Gentildonna-senpai!? Wh... Who are you?!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—"Doppelganger"...
A spitting-image double......... A
harbinger of unrest......—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(And... to my other self............
brings chaos and calamity............——!)

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!
...I'm no ordinary doppelgänger, you know?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Eep...!?
T-There's a hole... In the floor I just
cleaned, there's a hole!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
With this shape, I can smash aaaanything
to pieces!
AHAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"Looook at this shape! It's an exact
match, isn't it?
I mean, it looked juuuust like me from the
very start!"

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"Hopes, dreams, and all the bright things
those around me hold—
I'll crush them, shatter them, and tear
them apart with a single twist."

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
I'm gOoD aT thE sAmE tHiNg tOo! I'vE
bRoKeN lOtS oF tHiNgS tOo!
If iT's tHiS sHaPe, I cAn cOpY iT! I cAn!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"The mansion's spirits and dolls too. I
kneaded 'em allll together into one.
And made this shape that looks just like
meee!"

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"Simi-lar? It's similar, right? They're
the same, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Because I... gathered all my power into
this one single body
just so I could destroy happiness, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"............ In other words, to generate
power equivalent to Gentildonna's,
you mobilized all the ghosts in the
mansion."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, if it possesses a physical
form—then even we can fight back!
Blast-san, let us flank around to the
back!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"......Won't let you.
Phew......!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with this wind?!
What a monster lung capacity...
Waaaaahhhh—?!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu! Ahahahaha!
...What should I do next?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... we won't let you do anything
else...!
We will... stop you――...!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, a mysterious power, an abominable
power.
But that's not gonna... stop me
anymooore!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!)

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
Aha! I knew iT! Even she can't bLock the
iron ball!
My powEr is—

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: ............Can't be stopped, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Kh... Physical objects... can't be
blocked by "friends"...!
My power... isn't reaching............!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Still... I have to... stop that
doppelganger............!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Let me hear more!! The sound of happiness
breaking into pieces!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
You, and everyone else's happiness! I'll
destroy it all with my power!
Cower! Tremble! That's what I'm made for!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ――Then can you crush my happiness!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Look, see?! I look 200 miles worth of
happy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Gran-san...!?
You can't... Making yourself a target like
that is...—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—I'm fine. I can fight back.
Because I am "Gran Alegria."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, I'm about seventy-five
miles worth of angry at that fake claiming
to be Gentile-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't even scratch the surface of
Gentile-senpai.
That fake's power isn't 'the same' as
Gentile-senpai's at all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The Gentile-senpai I've watched all this
time is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
She's been dreaming foreeeever of taking
cute photos in cute dresses.
—She's just the sweetest, most adorable
Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why I brought everything needed
to wake Gentildonna-senpai up! Now—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna-senpai, wake up!!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh... Ahaha, hahaha!
Your voice won't reach that form. Because
I—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...How noisy.
So, Gran-san? What is that item you
brought?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's inside that basket over there!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"Wha... A... Aah...!?
Kuh—"

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: —Then put it to rest one more tiiime—...!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaat............!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we begin our counterattack?
